*Induction of cultures for protein expression*

11 cultures were induced b/w 12-1 PM

*ligN40 PCR 2*

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Final diluted DNA** | **800** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **2500** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **250** |
| **Water** | **1200**  |
| **Total** | **5000** |

25 uL per well in two 96-well plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **3X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

*ELF2lig1 PCR & EcoRV digestion*

16X

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ELFlig1** | **8 uL** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **200 uL** |
| **ELF\_FWD 10 uM** | **20 uL** |
| **ELF\_REV1 10 uM** | **20 uL** |
| **Water** | **152 uL** |
| **Total** | **400** |

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 59°C | 15 s       **35X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 10 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

For an EcoRV digest, set up a reaction with 1 ug of ELF2lig1 DNA and then column purify the PCR product.

*Gel run for Plasmid FS & HTFS samples*

1. 1 kb Extend ladder  
2. HAP1 HRS- 12  
3. HAP1 HRS- 18  
4. HepG2 HRS- 12  
5. HepG2 HRS- 18  
6. 147HTFS  
7. N40HTFS

*Transfer reconstituted nucleosomes to lower salt buffer*

Take 1 mini-dialysis column labeled F1 (293T20knuc). Equilibrate the column with Nucleosome Buffer C for 30 mins. Then transfer the reconstituted nucleosome to this column and allow dialysis for 1-2 hours. Follow this with transfer of the dialysis column to a larger volume 14-15 mL of the same buffer & leave O/N at 4 C.
